run_fairchem_cli: run a fairchem job from a YAML config file using the CLI with -c flag
load_hydra_config_from_yaml: load and parse a Hydra YAML config file with override arguments into a DictConfig
canonicalize_omegaconf_config: canonicalize an OmegaConf DictConfig by resolving variables and removing unused top-level keys
launch_slurm_job: launch a fairchem job on a SLURM cluster with optional Ray support from a config
launch_local_job: launch a fairchem job locally with optional Ray cluster or torch elastic mode
